name: 3D Box + Ice: Box 0 moves 4 north · 4t at (0, 5, 1) [case 130]
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 4 ticks after Start.
Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1); Box 0: 3 cells, starting at (0, 5, 2) through (1, 5, 2); Box 1: 5 cells, starting at (0, 5, 3) through (2, 5, 3); Box 2: 7 cells, starting at (0, 5, 4) through (3, 5, 4); Box 3: 9 cells, starting at (0, 5, 5) through (4, 5, 5); Box 4: 11 cells, starting at (0, 5, 6) through (5, 5, 6). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Ice.

Ticks 1–4 (each tick): Player moves 1 north; Box 0 moves 1 north.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
